Everything looks correct and complete.

## Summary

Implemented readable slug-based post URLs across the schema, backend, and frontend:

- **Schema/migration**: added `slug text not null unique` to `posts` (`db/schema.ts`), with a hand-fixed migration (`db/migrations/20260818070003_add_posts_slug/`) that backfills existing rows (`post-<id>`) before enforcing the NOT NULL/UNIQUE constraint via SQLite's table-recreate pattern — verified against a simulated pre-existing populated database.
- **Slug generation** (`app/Models/Post.ts`): a `slugify()` helper (lowercase, ASCII-only, hyphen-joined, `'post'` fallback) plus a `Post` model `creating` hook that assigns a unique slug once at creation time by probing `base`, `base-2`, `base-3`, … Titles are never re-slugged on update, so addresses stay stable.
- **Routing** (`routes/web.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`): `GET /posts/:slug` now handles both cases — a numeric segment looks up by id and issues a 301 to the slug URL, anything else is looked up by slug (404 if missing). `store`/`update` now redirect to the slug URL; edit/update/destroy stay id-based, unchanged.
- **Data plumbing**: `PostResource`/`PostResourceData` now include `slug`; `HomeController`/`PostController.index` pick it up automatically. Frontend links (`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`, `resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx`) now point at slug URLs.
- **Seeder** (`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`): sample posts get slugs via the same `slugify()`.
- Regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` codegen artifacts to reflect the new `posts.show` route shape.
- Added tests: `tests/Post.test.ts` (slug format, uniqueness numbering, stability on title edits) and new cases in `tests/PostController.test.ts` (200 on slug, 404 on unknown slug, 301 id→slug redirect, 404 on unknown id).

`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (9/9 tests).
